programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks

programme.title: ALVINNN!!! and The Chipmunks
programme.desc: Cheesy enlists Theodore and Alvin to steal desserts from the school kitchen in 'The Underground', then in 'Game House', Simon invents a virtual reality game that quickly gets out of hand. (S5, ep 25)
